cc:Work.dc:title: Technical drawing templates (ISO 5457 1999 Sizes A0-A4)
cc:Work.dc:description: A size {{A0-A4}} template for a technical product diagram. The template complies with recommendations of ISO 5457:1999(en). Title block complies with ISO 7200:2004(en). The font "osifont" (not included) complies with ISO 3098 (See https://tracker.debian.org/pkg/fonts-osifont ).
